title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2
description: Kanye West’s Yeezy Boost 350 V2 in Semi Frozen Yellow first hit stores in November 2017, with a restock that released on December 14, 2018. Dressed in adidas’ signature Primeknit upper, the lifestyle runner is finished in an energetic bright yellow hue, one that extends to the laces, heel tab, and Boost-infused ribbed rubber midsole. Zebra-like black stripes add another design dimension to the upper, along with a tonal side stripe emblazoned with ‘SPLY 350’ in reverse red print. A gum rubber outsole adds grippy traction to the eye-catching design.

title: YEEZY BOOST 380 INFANTS
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 380 Infants ‘Hylte’ dresses the sneaker’s re-engineered Primeknit upper in a complementary blend of tan and yellow hues, resulting in a subtle camo-like design that’s interrupted by a streak of neon green on the translucent monofilament window. The lightweight build is mounted on a full-length Boost midsole, encased in grey rubber and reinforced by a herringbone rubber outsole to provide reliable traction for little feet. The Yeezy Boost 380 Infants ‘Hylte’ is a regional exclusive and only launched in North America and Latin America.

title: YEEZY BASKETBALL
description: Marking his first foray into a hoops-inspired sneaker, the adidas Yeezy Basketball 'Quantum' brings Kanye West's avant-garde design language into a more functional design. This version's upper is divided up with a lace-up neoprene bootie, snakeskin-textured paneling and a suede toe. A semi-translucent casing contains responsive Boost cushioning, doubling as the outsole for directional traction.

title: YEEZY FOAM RUNNER INFANTS
description: The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner Infants ‘Onyx’ delivers a tonal colorway of Kanye West’s innovative slip-on. The molded one-piece upper is built with injected EVA foam, rendered in a stealthy black finish and shot through with a series of strategically mapped vents for enhanced breathability. A sculpted heel and a soft, textured footbed provide a snug and comfortable fit. adidas branding appears on the outsole, featuring a wavy traction pattern for optimal grip.
